May 8, 2026 RC Crawling Build

The C10 isn't a C10 anymore.

This is another SCX24 I’ve been working on. I bought a C10 version, but I’ve ended up replacing everything except the radio. I should have just bought a kit, but here it is now.

November 8, 2025 Field Note A school parking lot

Restored Pitts!

This is a Pitts RC biplane a friend gave me last year. I replaced the landing gear, repaired some linkages and bought a couple new batteries. After a few test flights at a school parking lot I can confirm it’s is airworthy again!
